{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.48

|gr1= Weapons

|gr2= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns currently selected throwable (and the muzzle it is loaded into), which will be launched if the user presses {{Controls|G}}.

|s1= [[currentThrowable]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [magazineName, muzzleName, id, ammoCount]
* magazineName: [[String]]
* muzzleName: [[String]]
* id: [[Array]] of [[Number]] pairs: [itemWorldID, creatorID]
* {{GVI|arma3|2.22|size= 0.75}} ammoCount: [[Number]] - magazine ammo

|x1= <sqf>currentThrowable player; // ["SmokeShellGreen", "SmokeShellGreenMuzzle", [1.00002e+007, 0], 1]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_ct = currentThrowable player;				// ["HandGrenade", "HandGrenadeMuzzle", [1e+007, 0], 1]
_id = (_ct select 2 select 0) - 1e7;		// 18
</sqf>

|seealso= [[selectThrowable]] [[currentWeapon]] [[currentMagazine]] [[currentMuzzle]] [[BIS_fnc_isThrowable]]
}}
